text:
Ava (Finance): Quick heads-up — I uploaded the new pricing experiment sheet for the A/B rollout. Two variants: A = small price bump + extended free tier, B = no bump + usage cap. Need signoff on grandfathering window and migration plan. Link: https://drive.redwood/pricing/1751234567
Mike (Sales): taking a look :eyes: What's the ask from sales? prefer A if it doesn't tank adoption.
Ava (Finance): Mike — decision request: prefer which variant for enterprise upsell offers vs PLG retention. Also need approval on 90-day grandfathering for existing customers vs 180-day for partners.
Tara (Ops): From ops POV, 90-day looks fine but need to know how many accounts will be migrated in each cohort. sheet has the cohort counts tab.
Ben (Fin Analyst): pasted quick calc from sheet for revenue delta (monthly):
```
Variant A delta = +$75k MRR (est)
Variant B delta = +$12k MRR (est)
Assumptions: 3% churn lift, 7% conversion uplift on enterprise trials
```
Ava (Finance): Also flagged vendor implications — Stripe subscription proration for grandfathering, plus potential invoices needing manual adjustments. @pricing-bot can you confirm whether we can auto-prorate for mixed plans?
pricing-bot: It is possible to issue prorated invoices via the Billing API. Manual adjustments may be required for legacy legacy-subscriptions that use our custom metering. See internal doc: https://internal.redwood/billing/proration
Priya (Legal): Need to add a short amendment for customers in the grandfathering cohort: explicit mention of price changes and opt-out window. I can draft language but want to avoid contractual regressions for annual contracts.
Mike (Sales): For enterprise deals in pipeline, can we carve out a negotiated price? we'd prefer to allow sales overrides and keep GA behavior consistent.
Nora (DevEx): Heads-up — SDK pricing labels and plan enums will need updates. We need a soft rollout to avoid breaking telemetry that parses plan names. Suggest a feature flag release.
Liam (EngOps): From infra side, the rollout needs two things: 1) traffic routing to new billing tier (feature flag) and 2) a fallback route to the old pricing if errors spike. I can wire the flag with a canary at 5% then 25/50/100.
Ava (Finance): Timeline proposal: freeze sheet for signoff by EOD Friday, engineering to schedule canary next Wed, full rollout after 2 successful days. Approvals needed: Sales (Mike), Legal (Priya), EngOps (Liam).
Priya (Legal): I can sign off on the amendment by Friday morning if Ben sends me the exact grandfathering text to review.
Ben (Fin Analyst): Sent proposed grandfathering statement to Priya in DM. Also uploaded per-customer impact CSV to the sheet.
Mike (Sales): thumbs up from me for Variant A with 90-day grandfathering, pending legal. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): Approved pending one wording tweak (will update in doc).
Ava (Finance): Great — marking as approved by Sales + Legal. Liam — please confirm you can start the 5% canary next Wed.
Liam (EngOps): Confirmed. I'll post the rollout ticket and link back here when created.
Ava (Finance): thanks all. If any blockers on Stripe proration edge cases, flag in this thread so finance can coordinate manual adjustments. :rocket:
